responsibility: Implements rs6000 expansion of block and string-like memory operations. It contains the target-specific heuristics and RTL generation for inline block clear, block move, and compare-style loads, choosing among scalar, VSX, Altivec, vector-pair, byte-reverse, and length-based load/store sequences depending on size, alignment, overlap, endianness, and ISA support, so GCC can lower memset/memcpy/memcmp-style operations efficiently on PowerPC.
